description: Implementation of ReceiveMatcher for channel reception in Gomega testing framework, including matching logic, failure messages, and future state checks.

classes.name: ReceiveMatcher
classes.description: A matcher for receiving from channels in tests, supporting optional sub-matchers and value assignment.

methods.name: Match
methods.description: Performs the match operation to receive from a channel, optionally applying a sub-matcher or assigning the received value.

methods.name: FailureMessage
methods.description: Returns a failure message when the match fails, considering if the channel is closed or if a sub-matcher is used.

methods.name: NegatedFailureMessage
methods.description: Returns a failure message for negated match scenarios, considering channel state and sub-matcher.

methods.name: MatchMayChangeInTheFuture
methods.description: Indicates if the match result may change in the future based on channel state.
